732812601.text: Hello. Are you ready to go?

732810101.text: Ah! If it isn't the esteemed Master of the Jinni, savior of my little Falcon.

732810102.text: I'm embarrassed to ask but could you do me another favor? It's a hunting task.

732810103.text: Simply put, this is about Tadhla's coming-of-age ceremony. Please witness her growth for me.

732810104.text: She could be a bit of a handful, but I promise you will be well compensated. So I'm wondering if you would like to...

732810105.text: Don't worry, just leave it to us!

732810110.text: It's the coming-of-age ceremony for Tadhla. I used to train the "Falcons" in the tribe personally, but now... I'm no longer as agile as I once was.

732810111.text: After the previous commission, Tadhla said you have her trust. This is why I want to ask you to join in and see the Falcon's growth.

732810113.text: It's very kind of you. Please find Tadhla. She'll give you the details of this hunt.

732810115.text: Well then, I shall leave you alone.

732812801.text: Prey won't hunt themselves for us. Please go find Tadhla to learn what needs to be done.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Red Vulture's lair
Search for traces of the Red Vulture on the way

732812901.text: Ah, you're back. Is there something else you want to talk about? Or are you just looking to chat?

732812903.text: I believe she will be a real Falcon after training with you.

732812905.text: Act alone or with company and hunt formidable targets, become a qualified "Falcon" for the tribe, and deal with prey and enemies...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Red Vulture's lair

732813201.text: *pant* If you need my assistance... please let me know, anytime.

732810502.text: Red Vultures are careful and wicked by nature. She's probably sensed the danger and fled already, leaving us an empty lair.

732810503.text: Now we must wait with patience.

732810505.text: Not until she no longer feels in danger... Also, even if she senses our presence in the lair, she'd still be forced back here by the piercing cold of midnight.

732810512.text: We will stay here and wait until midnight. Please have a rest if you are tired. I'll keep watch.

732810507.text: "Fool's Gold." Red Vultures love collecting shiny stuff.

732810508.text: "Fool's Gold"... Hmm... Sounds like Fatui's hidden treasure...

732810509.text: "Fool's Gold" are things that only simpletons would believe to be valuable.

732810510.text: Paimon certainly wouldn't fall for that!

732810511.text: Shh... You wouldn't want to have any of those. They are mostly commonplace alloys like brass and bronze that are not worth much.

732810601.text: ...She hasn't returned yet. Please stay put, or she'll be alarmed.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the hiding place and wait until the Red Vulture returns to the lair

732810801.text: ...She hasn't returned yet. Please stay put, or she'll be alarmed.

732812701.text: Ah, you are back. So, would you like to accept my commission?

732812703.text: Very well... Now, for detail of this hunt, please talk to Tadhla.

732812705.text: Well then, I shall leave you alone.

732810901.text: Please forgive me for having doubted you. You have proven that you are a talented hunter.

732810902.text: We may operate under different approaches, but I must say you have amazing instincts...

732810903.text: Please leave the rest to me. If you really are interested in this, I can teach you step by step.

732810906.text: Tadhla demonstrates how to dissect a prey. You and Paimon seem to have learned a new skill that you probably will never actually put into practice.

732810907.text: \nAfter the demonstration, Tadhla shows you her hands soaked by the blood of her prey, a faint smile appearing on her lips.\nThis is the first time that she has revealed any trace of her emotions.

732810911.text: Hmm... The smell of blood. Good.

732810912.text: Uh... The smell of blood is really strong! Aren't you going to wash it off or something?

732810913.text: No, because we are going to hunt the Scorpion now.

732810914.text: Scorpions are predators. They relish the smell of fresh blood.

732810916.text: Ohh... Alright... Paimon will hold her breath anyway!

732810917.text: Do you need more rest or should we set out right now?

732810918.text: It's decently chilly in this lair, our prey's meat should be able to stay overnight and not go bad... We could spend the night here to avoid the cold outside.

732810919.text: Yep yep, let's get some good rest while it's still chill and cozy in here.

732810920.text: It appears that the little one desires to be slothful again.

732810921.text: Hmph, Paimon knows when she feels cold and tired! Not everyone is immune to temperature changes like you!

732810910.text: Tadhla dissects the prey with great proficiency and wraps it up in a package.

732810701.text: *sigh* This would be the Red Vulture's lair.

732810703.text: I don't know if you're purely reckless, or highly instinctual... But we still have time.

732810704.text: Red Vultures are careful and wicked by nature. She's probably sensed the danger and fled already, leaving us an empty lair.

732810705.text: Now we must wait with patience.

732810707.text: Not until she no longer feels in danger... Also, even if she senses our presence in the lair, she'd still be forced back here by the piercing cold of midnight.

732810714.text: We will stay here and wait until midnight. Please have a rest if you are tired. I'll keep watch.

732810709.text: "Fool's Gold." Red Vultures love collecting shiny stuff.

732810710.text: "Fool's Gold"... Hmm... Sounds like Fatui's hidden treasure...

732810711.text: "Fool's Gold" are things that only simpletons would believe to be valuable.

732810712.text: Paimon certainly wouldn't fall for that!

732810713.text: Shh... You wouldn't want to have any of those. They are mostly commonplace alloys like brass and bronze that are not worth much.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Tadhla and set out together

732811001.text: You are such a talented hunter. No wonder Father commissioned you to help me with this hunt.

732811002.text: Please leave the rest to me. If you really are interested in this, I can teach you step by step.

732811005.text: Tadhla demonstrates how to dissect a prey. You and Paimon seem to have learned a new skill that you probably will never actually put into practice.

732811006.text: After the demonstration, Tadhla shows you her hands soaked by the blood of her prey, a faint smile appearing on her lips.\nThis is the first time that she has revealed any trace of her emotions.

732811010.text: Hmm... The smell of blood. Good.

732811011.text: Paimon can smell it, too! Uh... Such a strong smell... Aren't you going to wash it off?

732811012.text: No, because we are going to hunt the Scorpion now.

732811013.text: Scorpions are predators. They relish the smell of fresh blood.

732811015.text: Ohh... Alright... Paimon will hold her breath anyway!

732811016.text: Do you need more rest or should we set out right now?

732811017.text: It's decently chilly in this lair, our prey's meat should be able to stay overnight and not go bad... We could spend the night here to avoid the cold outside.

732811018.text: Sounds good to Paimon! The temperature feels just right in here. Let's all just get some good rest for the night!

732811019.text: It appears that the little one desires to be slothful again.

732811020.text: Hmph, Paimon knows when she feels cold and tired! Not everyone is immune to temperature changes like you!

732811021.text: Tadhla fetches some desert poplar branches and dried feces. Soon, a simple campfire is built.\nSitting and bathing in its warm light, you all share filling quantities of food and water with each other.\nWatching the campfire dancing and crackling, you find yourselves absent of any topics to discuss...

732811009.text: Tadhla dissects the prey with great proficiency and wraps it up in a package.

subQuests.subQuestName: Rest for a night and talk to Tadhla

732813803.text: I'll lead the way. Please follow me.

732811101.text: Tadhla fetches some desert poplar branches and dried feces. Soon, a simple campfire is built.\nSitting and bathing in its warm light, you all share filling quantities of food and water with each other.\nWatching the campfire dancing and crackling, you find yourselves absent of any topics to discuss...

732811104.text: He is my father. I am his "Falcon."

732811111.text: There's nothing much to say about me... Are you sure you want to know more about me?

732811202.text: Scorpions are only active under the veil of night. There is still some time before the night falls. Why don't we plan how we hunt the Scorpion?

732811203.text: First option, we can mix the secretions of Sand Grease Pupa with a few ground poisonous mushrooms. Secretions of Sand Grease Pupa should lure the Scorpion to take the bait, then ground poisonous mushrooms can paralyze the Scorpion.

732811204.text: The toxin is not strong enough to kill it, but would very well suffice to immobilize it.

732811205.text: Or, we can mash up a mixture of Henna Berries and viper venom. Then make some poisonous bait by adding fresh meat into the mush. We fight fire with fire.

732811206.text: But viper venom is a rare resource. It'll be a huge waste to use it all for the bait... I'll adjust the portions to make sure the bait is just poisonous enough to weaken the Scorpion but not kill it.

732811207.text: There's also a third method... Not a clever one though. We risk our lives to hunt it down without any of preparation.

732811208.text: But this method has its merits, too. It avoids any contamination so that we can extract the purest Scorpion venom.

732811209.text: I'll leave the final choice to you. Please take your time.

732811210.text: Oh, one more thing. When fighting with the Scorpion, we must be very careful. Its toxin can be lethal.

732811212.text: Very well... Are there any cuts or scratches on your hands?

732811213.text: Tadhla prepares the poisonous bait carefully as you wait patiently in the cave until the moon rises...

732811216.text: Be careful and don't cut yourself. It'll be a disaster if viper venom gets into your body.

732811217.text: Tadhla prepares the poisonous bait carefully as you wait patiently in the cave until the moon rises...

732811218.text: It has been weakened. Let's go!

732811220.text: Then I will watch your back.

subQuests.subQuestName: Conceal yourself in the hiding place

732811301.text: We need to wait patiently... They should've smelled the blood, but they won't be active before the night falls.

732811701.text: ...Thank you. You didn't have to do this for me.

732811707.text: No... Um... Just a little bit, but it doesn't matter.

732811901.text: Wait... I feel it... The familiar... pain.

732811902.text: It is my soul, my fragments... One is around here...

732811903.text: This place is a habitat for flying serpents. Seems this oasis is powered by one of the Jinni's fragments and has become an ecosystem for them...

732811904.text: That's right. Uh... No, I can't sense the fragment due to the interference of the flying serpents here. Their scents are too thick, too pungent...

732811905.text: Then let's go deep and take them down!

732811907.text: I guess you wanted to say "Let's go!" but you'd better stand down and take a break.

732811908.text: ...I'll check the Flying Serpent up ahead.

732811912.text: She means to say that "It hurts."

732811915.text: Yes, you should get some rest!

732811918.text: #Yes, from now on, you can totally count on us! Umm, Paimon means you can totally count on {NICKNAME}!

732812002.text: Don't say that, you deserve some rest! There's nothing wrong with us helping out when you're not feeling so well. We're friends after all!

732812003.text: I am but a Falcon of Masseira's.

732812010.text: Ah... Pardon me, my master, but I... sense my fragment nearby.

732812011.text: ...It's okay. I'll go take care of our prey.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk after defeating the Flying Serpent
Let the Jinni open the stone wall

732812101.text: As the shard of light merges with Liloupar's magic bottle, you feel a little of your own power being pulled away...

732812102.text: Through the Jinni's entranced eyes, you see a vortex of decay and betrayal...\nThe Spirit of Victory fell into madness due to a signet ring most dark, and in a series of tragedies, Queen Shirin brewed the honey-colored catastrophe before her mind yielded to hysteria...\nThe people turned against each other, and the Jinn scattered across the lands... Broken souls became fuel to a titanic machine, and the mindless descendants of the Seelie were degraded into slaves of infinite power...

732812103.text: Then, the merciless era of the Spirit of Victory began... The crazed king and the nobles rejoiced in their superiority...\nYet none were aware that all the happenings within Gurabad were created by the scheming hands of the Mother of the Jinn...

732812104.text: My master, are you feeling alright?

732812107.text: Apologies. Experiencing a Jinni's memories is not necessarily always a pleasant experience.

732812109.text: What have I done? You should see what they have done... With just a nudge, they would have cast themselves down the vile path toward certain ruination.

732812110.text: The fall of Gurabad... is just a prologue. I merely revealed what torments await.

732812111.text: Alright, now is not the time for such a topic... Your friends are waiting for you to wake up.

732812112.text: Are you awake? Can you not always scare Paimon to death!?

732812113.text: Oh, you are finally awake. Paimon was so worried about you...

732812114.text: So was Tadhla! When you fell unconscious, she was really nervous and almost cried! Paimon thinks you owe Tadhla an apology!

732812501.text: We are back. This is the prey you asked for.

732812502.text: A little later than I expected. What happened, my little Falcon?

732812503.text: It's embarrassing to say. I... I got injured. But thanks to the Master of the Jinni, I'm okay now.

732812505.text: Good, very good. It's good to see you're alright.

732812506.text: Esteemed Master of the Jinni, did my Falcon hold you back?

732812509.text: Very well. Thank you very much.

732812515.text: But... Falcons belong to hunters, not the earth. Once Falcons get attached to the world, their senses and claws will be dull. If that happens, how can I expect them to hunt for me?

732812516.text: That doesn't make any sense to Paimon... But hearing you going on and on about Falcons surely makes Paimon irritated!

732812517.text: Tadhla is human, and our friend! Not some sort of so-called "Falcon"!

732812520.text: I will deal with you later.

732812521.text: Haha, please, don't get me wrong! I am most happy that my little Falcon has made some new friends! Truly, I am.

732812522.text: Here, this is your payment. Please do come find me later. I'll probably have other commissions for you.

732812525.text: My little Falcon, let's talk about your next "hunt," shall we?

732812512.text: Very well. Thank you very much.

732812514.text: I know that, of course. She's my Falcon, after all.

732810201.text: Hello, thank you for your help.

732810202.text: Tadhla! Looks like you're in better spirits now! How's your wound now? Has it healed?

732810203.text: Thank you for asking. Yes, it has healed... but left an indelible scar.

732810204.text: No need to worry about me. Master... I mean, my father must have given you this commission.

732810211.text: There are three targets for this hunt: the Red Vulture, the Scorpion, and the Flying Serpent.

732810212.text: First, the Red Vulture. We have already confirmed its whereabouts. All that needs to be done is to track it down.

732810213.text: But of course, if you have other priorities, I'll wait here until you're all set. Only the prey won't be as patient as I am...

732810210.text: That's not the target for this hunt. My apologies.

732810922.text: Tadhla fetches some desert poplar branches and dried feces. Soon, a simple campfire is built.\nSitting and bathing in its warm light, you all share filling quantities of food and water with each other.\nWatching the campfire dancing and crackling, you find yourselves absent of any topics to discuss...

732812401.text: Ah, esteemed master of the Jinni! And eh... Hmm. I see you have both returned.

732815001.text: Ah, the distinguished Master of the Jinni. If you are here for Tadhla, it might not be a convenient time.

732815003.text: I am her Father, she is my Falcon. Although she is not the only Falcon that has grown up under my tutelage, she is the one that I trust the most.

732815004.text: Trust is invaluable. It is something that concerns life and death in this tribe.

732815006.text: I am a hunter in the tribe, but I'm getting old and not as strong and agile as before... In time, your friend Jeht will take the place of old timers like me.

732815007.text: So, I have high hopes for Tadhla. When the day comes that I have to retire, I need to have at least one Falcon that I can trust.

732815009.text: Tanit is our tribe, our home.

732815010.text: In the desert, no one can survive without the protection of the tribe. Also, if the tribe needs to take someone's life, how can they escape under the omnipresence of the "eyes" and "claws" of our Falcons?

732815012.text: May patterns on the sand dunes guide your way, esteemed Master of the Jinni.

732815101.text: Did you finish dealing with the Jinn matter?

732815103.text: Please don't worry about me. I'm still busy with something...

732815105.text: Yes, it doesn't hurt anymore. *grunt* It's okay now.

732815201.text: Hello, the Master of the Jinni.

732815203.text: Nothing to worry about. No need to worry about me.

732819901.text: Please follow me. We have already confirmed its whereabouts. All that needs to be done is to track it down.

732819902.text: By the way, are you wearing any perfume?

732819905.text: I can smell the lair. Yes, it is right there.

732819910.text: Paimon, you've been holding your nose the whole time.

732819912.text: But all the scents that greet me are from wild creatures... Ah, it is not so foul.

732819913.text: Ah, speaking of which, where "is" your nose?

732819916.text: Tadhla, you don't look so well. Do you need some rest?

732819918.text: Falcons get injured, too. There's no need to be ashamed of such facts, little one.

732819920.text: Phew... Easy peasy! Paimon didn't even break a sweat!

732819922.text: Eh? What's wrong, Tadhla? Are you still feeling unwell?

732819924.text: Should you bear words, give them unto my master now.

732819926.text: I... I am very happy to hunt with you.

732819928.text: Well... that's a first for a Falcon.

732819929.text: Hmm... The Red Vulture won't be back anytime soon. Why don't we check out the <color=#00E1FFFF>shiny stuff</color> first?
